items.title: Claude Code sends your email address to websites
items.summary: Security issue where Claude Code unintentionally leaks the user's email address to visited sites.

items.title: Alpine Linux Security Advisory: OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass
items.summary: Critical vulnerability allowing password‑authentication bypass on Alpine Linux's OpenSSH server.
items.why_it_matters: Directly affects any cloud or on‑prem SSH access used to manage AI workloads.
items.next_step_detail: Run `apk upgrade openssh && rc-service sshd restart` or disable PasswordAuthentication in sshd_config.

items.title: OpenSSH 10.6p2 Critical workaround for alpine without PAM

items.why_it_matters: Directly impacts the security of servers running Python agents or LLM services on Alpine containers.
items.next_step_detail: Update Alpine containers to OpenSSH 10.6p2 or later: apk add --upgrade openssh.

items.title: NVIDIA / Model-Optimizer
items.summary: Model-Optimizer is a Python library that bundles state‑of‑the‑art model compression techniques—quantization, pruning, distillation, NAS, speculative decoding—and outputs models ready for TensorRT‑LLM, vLLM, and other serving stacks.
items.why_it_matters: Enables rapid, production‑grade optimization of local LLMs, directly reducing inference cost for autonomous‑agent services.
items.next_step_detail: Run `pip install nvidia-model-optimizer` and benchmark a small model with `model_optimizer.optimize(your_model)`.

items.title: vercel-labs / agent-browser

items.next_step_detail: Run `cargo install agent-browser && agent-browser --help` and test with a simple navigation script.

items.title: MCP Explained
items.summary: Describes the Model Connectivity Protocol (MCP), an open standard for connecting AI applications to external tools and data sources via a server‑mediated request/response model.

items.title: Launch HN: Rivet (YC W23) – Scale and Orchestrate Agents on S3
items.summary: Rivet is an open‑source framework that lets you deploy, scale, and orchestrate multiple AI agents using Amazon S3 as a coordination layer. It includes tooling for state persistence, task routing, and parallel execution.
items.why_it_matters: Enables production‑grade multi‑agent workflows without building custom orchestration infrastructure.
items.next_step_detail: Run `pip install rivet && rivet quickstart` to spin up a sample agent pipeline on your AWS account.

items.title: Inkling 2 Small
